thread:
maria: Quick idea: surface the effective SLO + who controls notifications on the per-route card in Console. Low-risk change but we need an API shape and telemetry before we flip it on.
ben: Sounds useful. Will this encourage people to tweak thresholds and explode alert volume?
kai: Mock is here: https://redwood.internal/figma/slo-route-card-v1 (private)
trina: We should not show raw tenant policies by default. Show the effective threshold and a small "policy source" chip: tenant | org | route. Default UI: read-only until they click edit.
maria: Proposal: server returns fields: effective_threshold, source, notify_control (read-only flag), and an optional notify_policy_v2 blob we can use for editing.
ben: For a minimal v2 contract I sketched this payload (server -> client):
```json
{
  "route_id": "route_0xabc",
  "effective_threshold": "99.0",
  "source": "tenant",
  "notify_controlled_by_tenant": true,
  "notify_policy_v2": "...opaque until edit screen"
}
```
kai: UI needs provenance badges: tenant-managed vs route-overridable. Also show a compact suppression indicator when quieting is active.
trina: Telemetry requirements: emit an event when the console surfaces a threshold: {"slo_surface_shown": true, "route_id": "...", "effective_threshold": "...", "source": "..."}. For notifications we track pre_suppress_matches and post_suppress_emitted counts per evaluation window.
maria: Add suppression_reason with values: QUIET_WINDOW, NOISE_PROFILE, MANUAL_OVERRIDE, SAMPLING. Include sample_rate_used.
ben: Implementation note: notify routing should be decoupled from suppression controls. I suggest split objects: notify_routing (channels, escalation) and noise_controls (quiet_window_secs, sample_rate, backoff_secs).
maria: Rollout plan: server returns new fields in a backward-compatible envelope (fields optional). Start with server-only flag for 2 weeks, collect telemetry. Then enable read-only UI for 5% tenants, then 25%.
ai-deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: slo-route-card-readonly -> group 5% on 2026-04-02T14:00:00Z.
trina: We also need gating queries: alert_volume_delta (new_ui vs baseline) and suppressed_alerts_ratio. If volume spikes >10% we pause rollout.
ben: I'll draft the RFC covering API shape, migration, and telemetry queries. Will include examples of gating SQL.
kai: I'll update the mock and add states for suppressed/overridden. Also add hover help explaining provenance and suppression.
maria: Tests: schema validation, UI showing provenance correctly, and an e2e that asserts suppressed alerts do not reach PD when quiet_window applies. Also telemetry smoke for pre/post counts.
trina: Thanks team, ping me when RFC is ready and we'll pick dates for the UI toggles. :thumbsup:
